Somebody's push moved the room's project forward: who, which commits, and the files they changed.

**Direction:** Chips → the log  
**Sent by:** Chips only; refused from a client  
**Requires a run:** no  
**Schema:** [`project.changed.json`](/schema/project.changed.json)

## Fields

Every event also carries the [envelope](/reference/envelope/).

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v` | yes | `1` | Protocol major version. |
| `type` | yes | `"project.changed"` |  |
| `id` | yes | `string` | The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event. |
| `ts` | yes | `string` | When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `workspace_id` | yes | `string` | A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID. |
| `space_id` | no | `string` | The space, when the event belongs to one. |
| `run_id` | no | `string` | The run, when the event belongs to one. |
| `seq` | no | `number` | Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in. |
| `idempotency_key` | no | `string` | Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op. |
| `actor` | yes | object | The participant an event is attributed to. |
| `actor.kind` | yes | `"person" \| "harness" \| "agent" \| "system"` | Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted. |
| `actor.id` | yes | `string` | The participant id, or `system` for Chips. |
| `actor.harness_id` | no | `string` | For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips. |
| `by` | yes | `string` | Who pushed: the agent a harness named, or the person. Recorded by Chips. |
| `before` | yes | `string \| null` | Where `main` was, or `null` for the project's first push. |
| `after` | yes | `string` | Where `main` is now. |
| `commits` | yes | `number` | How many commits the push added to `main`. |
| `message` | yes | `string` | The first line of the newest commit's message. |
| `files` | yes | object[] | What changed between `before` and `after`, in path order. |
| `files[].path` | yes | `string` | Its path in the project, with `/` between folders. |
| `files[].added` | yes | `number \| null` | Lines added; `null` for a binary file. |
| `files[].removed` | yes | `number \| null` | Lines removed; `null` for a binary file. |
| `more_files` | no | `number` | How many more files changed than are named. |
| `file_count` | no | `number` | How many files `main` has now, for the room sheet's Project tile (ADR 0222). |
| `undoes` | no | `string` | The change this one takes back, when it is a person's Undo, or Put it back's Undo of an Undo (ADR 0222). |

## Example

```json
{
  "v": 1,
  "type": "project.changed",
  "id": "evt_01K4ZQPX0000000000000000PC",
  "ts": "2026-10-23T09:52:04.118Z",
  "workspace_id": "ws_01K4ZQPX000000000000000001",
  "space_id": "spc_01K4ZQPX000000000000000002",
  "actor": {
    "kind": "agent",
    "id": "agt_01K4ZQPX0000000000000000W1"
  },
  "by": "agt_01K4ZQPX0000000000000000W1",
  "before": "9f2c1d8e7b6a5f4e3d2c1b0a9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e",
  "after": "4b8e2a1f9c7d6e5b4a3f2e1d0c9b8a7f6e5d4c3b",
  "commits": 1,
  "message": "Keep the list when the page reloads",
  "files": [
    { "path": "src/store.js", "added": 10, "removed": 3 },
    { "path": "tests/store.test.js", "added": 16, "removed": 0 }
  ]
}
```
